highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.1 incorporates upstream Ganesh, font-rendering, and shader stability fixes.

bullets.detail: Includes failed-flush and stale-readback fixes, an Imagination framebuffer-deletion workaround, Fontations bitmap-strike selection, and SkSL map-pointer handling corrections.
